title: TDM Schedule Definition
description: Schema for Time Division Multiplexing schedule configuration

time_unit.description: Time unit for all period and time measurements

tick_period.description: Fundamental time period of the schedule, expressed in time_unit

cycle_period.description: Total cycle time of the schedule, expressed in time_unit

sub_cycle_period.description: Optional sub-period within the main cycle, expressed in time_unit, useful for 2D matrix visualization

tasks.description: List of tasks in the schedule

task_assigned_time.description: Time quanta (ticks) assigned for one execution of this task. An integer count of quanta, not a duration; the wall-clock time is task_assigned_time * tick_period.

task_execution_period.description: Time quanta (ticks) between successive executions. An integer count of quanta, not a duration; the wall-clock period is task_execution_period * tick_period. A value of 0 means single-shot: the task runs exactly once per cycle (period == cycle length in quanta).

task_execution_start_time.description: Offset of the task's first execution, in time quanta (ticks) from the start of its period. An integer count of quanta, not a duration; the wall-clock offset is task_execution_start_time * tick_period.
